response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and leadership in project development, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML modeling, and formal team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical requirement for this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across diverse technologies and domains
Active open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor through workshops and community work
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, falling far short of the required C1 level
No clear evidence of UML expertise, IT architecture design, or formal project leadership responsibilities
Lacks documented experience in client advisory, compliance, or risk management in IT consulting contexts
